services.description: List of load-balanced services to configure. Each service defines a virtual IP, protocol, and backend pool.

type.description: Service type: 'lb' for load balancer, 'fw' for firewall/redirect.

proto.description: Protocol to listen on: tcp, udp, or sctp.

listen_ip.description: IP address to bind the service to (e.g., 192.168.1.10 or 0.0.0.0).

backends.description: List of backend servers to distribute traffic to.

ip.description: IP address of the backend server.

port.description: Port on which backend listens (defaults to service's listen_port if omitted).

weight.description: Relative weight for weighted load balancing (higher = more traffic).

path.description: HTTP path to probe for 'http' health checks.

global_settings.description: Global nftlb settings affecting overall behavior.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error.

persistence_default.description: Default persistence timeout (seconds) for connections without per-service override.
